{{Top|leg}}
'''Laboian mineral crystals''' were natural formations of crystal found on the planet [[Laboi II]]. During the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] scorching daylight hours, the minerals melted into pools of molten rock. However, at night, they solidified into elaborate mineral crystals. The [[Laboi]], the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], tended pools of liquid mineral with [[stir-stick]]s or [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] in order to form them into crystal gardens.
